criteria.description: Parameterize all queries and sanitize external inputs to prevent SQL, OS command, and code injection attacks; cite sanitization boundaries.
Enforce least privilege, verify caller identity and authorization checks, and prevent Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR); cite authorization gates.
Zero hardcoded credentials, API keys, certificates, or tokens in source or configuration; verify secrets resolve exclusively from environment/vault; cite config lines.
Catch and sanitize runtime failures without revealing internal stack traces, database schema, or infrastructure topology to external clients; cite error handlers.
